one_liner: Meta’s enterprise APIs for sending/receiving WhatsApp messages and calls, plus programmatic account and template management.
access_notes: Use Embedded Signup to mint BISU tokens; production, multi-tenant use requires App Review and Advanced access.
mcp_notes: No official vendor MCP server is documented for WhatsApp Business; community MCP servers exist but are not official.
blocker_notes: Production, multi-tenant use requires App Review and Advanced access for whatsapp_business_messaging and usually whatsapp_business_management.

evidence.quote: “When making API requests, include your token in an authorization request header, preceded by ‘Bearer’…”
“If you are a partner… your app must undergo App Review, and you must be approved for Advanced access…”
“Webhooks deliver JSON payloads… The platform relies heavily on webhooks”
“When you get started with Cloud API, a test WhatsApp account, test Messaging account, and test business phone number are automatically created for you…”
